objective: Prepare a small, license-traceable, labeled, group-isolated ALPR correctness-evaluation package without invoking any model.

selected_task.input: One original full-resolution UFPR-ALPR image. Ground-truth vehicle, plate, and character boxes are retained as metadata but are not provided to the model.
selected_task.output: The single visible Brazilian license-plate text only.
selected_task.scope_label: full-image plate-text recognition with implicit localization; not a scored plate-box detector
normalization: remove all characters other than A-Z and 0-9
selected_task.prediction_parsing: Apply the same normalization to the entire raw model response; do not select a favorable substring or edit a response after seeing the label.
selected_task.character_error_rate: Levenshtein(normalized_prediction, normalized_label) / len(normalized_label); do not clip values above 1.0
selected_task.uncertain_policy: Preserve the sample and raw label with uncertain=true when the official label is missing, contains an illegible marker, or cannot be reconciled with the source annotation. Exclude it from the primary exact-match/CER denominator, but report its count and reason.
selected_task.label_provenance: Official UFPR-ALPR per-image annotation only; no label may be generated or corrected by the evaluated model.

sampling_plan.group_key: The official UFPR-ALPR vehicle/video identity. Verify the archive representation before selection; do not infer a weaker image-level group if it is unavailable.
sampling_plan.eligible_pool: Official UFPR-ALPR test split only, after verifying that all 30 frames from each vehicle/video remain in one official split.
sampling_plan.group_order: Sort eligible group IDs by SHA-256(seed + ':' + group_id), ascending hexadecimal digest.
sampling_plan.frame_order: Within each selected group, sort relative image paths by SHA-256(seed + ':frame:' + relative_path), ascending hexadecimal digest, and choose the first decodable frame with a present official label matching the frozen task definition.
sampling_plan.split_assignment: First 4 selected groups become development; next 8 become locked_check.
sampling_plan.fallback_when_fewer_groups: Use every eligible group without duplication. Assign up to the first 4 groups to development and all remaining groups to locked_check; if fewer than 2 groups exist, stop because group isolation cannot be formed.
forbidden: copying, cropping, augmenting, or selecting adjacent frames to inflate independent sample count
moving frames from one vehicle/video across development and locked_check
selection based on model output, expected difficulty, or expected algorithm advantage
allowed_exclusions: official label missing or structurally invalid for the frozen task
source group identity unavailable or inconsistent

integrity_plan.near_duplicate_aid: 64-bit perceptual hash; flag cross-group Hamming distance <= 6 for local human review
integrity_plan.near_duplicate_boundary: Perceptual hash is an aid only. Source vehicle/video identity is primary and semantic independence must be reviewed locally.

candidates.source_type: official university laboratory dataset site and original paper
candidates.access: Manual e-mail request from a valid university account; the requester must accept the official terms; author states a link is generally issued in 1-3 workdays.
candidates.registration_or_click_acceptance: Human acceptance and author approval required; Codex must not accept or send the application on the user's behalf without a new explicit instruction.
candidates.payload: 4,500 PNG images at 1920x1080 plus per-image text annotations; 150 one-second, 30-FPS vehicle videos/groups, 30 frames per vehicle.
candidates.labels: Plate identity/text, plate position, character positions, camera, and vehicle metadata.
candidates.group_identity: Official vehicle/video identity; strong fit for group isolation.
candidates.minimum_download_unit: The author-issued archive; no official public per-vehicle download unit is documented.
candidates.planning_size_estimate: About 10.8 GB decimal from 4,500 images times a published secondary estimate of 2.4 MB per PNG; not an official archive size. Stop if the author-issued payload exceeds the separately approved cap.
candidates.privacy_and_redistribution: Contains identifiable license plates. Non-commercial academic research only; redistribution, modification, and commercial use require express VRI permission; publication/presentation demonstration is allowed under the stated privacy condition.
candidates.adapter_training_overlap: UNKNOWN: the local ALPR adapter model card says it was trained on an unknown dataset.

candidates.license: MIT as explicitly stated for the dataset by the original repository
candidates.access: Public Google Drive or Baidu archive; no author registration is documented. A large-file confirmation page may appear; do not log in or use credentials.
candidates.registration_or_click_acceptance: No separate dataset terms acceptance documented by the original repository.
candidates.payload: CCPD2019.tar.xz with more than 300,000 JPEG images and labels embedded in filenames.
candidates.labels: Plate text, plate box, four plate vertices, area, tilt, brightness, and blurriness encoded in each filename.
candidates.group_identity: No independent vehicle/video field is documented. A salted hash of normalized plate text can serve only as a vehicle proxy group and must be labeled as such.
candidates.minimum_download_unit: One full CCPD2019.tar.xz archive from the original repository link.
candidates.size_evidence_boundary: Size and SHA-256 were exposed by an archival host, not by the original Google Drive page; both must be verified after any authorized download.
candidates.privacy_and_redistribution: MIT permits redistribution, but plate text is potentially identifying; project policy still keeps raw images and unhashed labels out of public Git and external AI services.
candidates.adapter_training_overlap: UNKNOWN: the local ALPR adapter model card says it was trained on an unknown dataset.
